name: Project Env Config
description: A Claude Code plugin skill that configures development environments for cloned projects.
longDescription: This entry points at the repository's `.claude-plugin` folder itself, so installing it delivers only `plugin.json`; the skill proper is `skills/project-env-config/SKILL.md` in the repository root of ConanXu-math/project-env-config. That skill sets up a freshly cloned project step by step, each step confirmed by the user: it scans for dependency files, identifies the project type (Django, Flask, FastAPI, React, Next.js and others), checks the tools on the machine, lets the user pick a Python environment (`venv`, `uv` or `conda`) or the Node package manager, runs the setup, and creates `.env` from `.env.example` with masked input for secrets. Handles mixed backend and frontend projects; no license file.
